Independent first judgment: PARTIAL. RFC4271 Section 9.1.3 prohibits advertising a route unless its destination and NEXT_HOP may be forwarded appropriately by the Routing Table. Tested is "may be forwarded appropriately by the Routing Table"; Gap is "installed in the Adj-Rib-Out". These disjoint quotation selectors locate the obligation; the actual tested scope is the ordinary IPv4 internal-plugin lifecycle with one continuously connected iBGP recipient under default Routing-Table policy. The genuine remaining gap-context Producer is internal/component/bgp/plugins/rib/rib_selected_dispatch.go::selectedDispatch.destinationUp: equivalent exclusion on new-recipient or replacement-session replay remains unproven. Existing forked next-hop and prospective-next-hop functional carriers exercise remote admission, reselection and forwarding-table recovery; they are not unimplemented behavior. The corresponding stable successful-write destination/NEXT_HOP oracle on ordinary recipient output across those remote boundaries remains unproven by the present cover. These are testing gaps, not demonstrated product defects, and give zero whole-requirement credit.

TestRFC4271OrdinaryOutputRequiresForwardableRoute has distinct positive and negative oracles. Real received source input is retained through actual plugins and Sessions. An independently resolvable control must reach the ordinary internal recipient. The initially unresolved subject must have zero captured announcements and no destination cover after ingress, plugin-event, forwarding and recipient-capture settlement. Subsequent interior-route insertion, removal and restoration require useful announcement, service withdrawal and recovery without another source UPDATE. Every successful comparable subject/control write is paired with complete independently captured history. The observer samples the destination host and the actual emitted NEXT_HOP under one stable Routing-Table revision before the underlying write, accepts only complete successful writes, and checks the revision again afterward. Framing errors, short writes, revision crossings, history loss and observer overflow fail the fixture rather than count as success.

Independently read both accepted receipts and their actual canonical positive/negative records. job-rfc4271-forwardability-mirror-proof-40cca134.log has clean PASS, package 1.089s. Omitting only ordinary CIDR mirroring produces broken package 1.040s: the first nonfatal assertion identifies a successful control announcement with an unresolved destination while its NEXT_HOP remains resolved. Later subject-destination, loss-withdrawal and history assertions also fail. There is no fatal or revision-indeterminate outcome; the full lifecycle and cleanup execute. This proves the positive destination-forwardability oracle is substantive, rather than merely checking successful delivery.

job-rfc4271-forwardability-unresolved-proof-a0fd9833.log has clean PASS, package 1.018s. Bypassing only local prospective next-hop admission produces broken package 1.084s: first the initial forbidden subject announcement count fails nonfatally, then the unexpected destination-cover assertion is fatal. All later body and lifecycle checks are skipped. Cleanup still reports the successful comparable subject write with both destination and emitted NEXT_HOP unresolved. The normal-return cuts isolate different required conditions; no later skipped oracle or independent withdrawal mutant is claimed for the negative record.

RFC4271 Sections 3.2 and 9.1 define conceptual tables and equivalent externally visible behavior. The actual ownership/writer path records admitted output, flushes before reporting success, and retires failed writes. No physical Adj-RIB-Out object, kernel acknowledgment or blanket other-family matrix is invented as an additional obligation. Section 9.1.3's explicit local-policy exception is preserved and not exercised. The existing default lifecycle is implemented and passes these scoped baselines; replay and remote-boundary proof remain open under the existing best-route advertiser owner. The actual job-rfc4271-forwardability-two-cover-freshness-93efd4bc.log lists exactly the positive and negative records current under the applied partial annotation, with stale and unproven empty. The two canonical records use the same bare enclosing-function unit with distinct polarities and claims; audit tag bindings and fingerprints are native-derived. Current record freshness does not supply whole-row credit or close replay and remote-output testing gaps.
